content.text: {"concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","title":"Distance vs Displacement","quick":"Distance is the total path length covered, no matter the direction. Displacement is the shortest straight line from start point to end point, with direction. Distance is always equal or more than displacement.","full":"Think of Ishika walking to the kirana shop and back home. If the shop is 200m away, she walks 200m there and 200m back, so total distance is 400m. But since she ends up at the same place she started, her displacement is 0m, because displacement only cares about how far the final point is from the starting point, in a straight line, with direction. Distance just adds up every step she took, even if she went in circles. Displacement only looks at start and end. They look alike because both measure 'how much she moved' but distance can never be less than displacement, while displacement can even be zero when distance is not.","traps":["Thinking distance and displacement are always equal","Forgetting displacement can be zero even after walking a lot","Not mentioning direction as part of displacement"],"misconception":"Children think distance and displacement are just two names for the same thing, the total length walked.","parent_questions":[{"q":"If you walk 5 steps forward and 5 steps back, what is your distance and what is your displacement?","expected_answer_hint":"Distance = 10 steps, Displacement = 0, since she returned to start."},{"q":"Why does displacement need direction but distance does not?","expected_answer_hint":"Displacement tells shortest path from start to end with a direction, distance is just total path length covered."}],"check_question":{"q":"Raju walks 3km east and then 3km west back to his starting point. What is his displacement?","options":["0 km","6 km","3 km"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! He ends at the same place, so displacement is zero even though distance is 6km.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Displacement only looks at start and end point, which are the same here, so it is 0 km."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A girl walking from her home to a small neighborhood shop and back along a street, shown with footprints marking her path.","labels":[{"text":"home","position":"left"},{"text":"shop","position":"right"},{"text":"path walked","position":"bottom"},{"text":"straight line","position":"top"}]}}
